text:
alex: Morning team — quick async standup. Pipeline highlights: Novara Health is in legal (expected SOW by Thu), FinEdge POC passed tech review and we start onboarding next Tue, and OrionData requested extended trial until end of month. Blocker: Novara asking for VPC peering + EKM/HSM timeline. @maria can you sync with infra/eng?

maria: On it. I pinged infra yesterday but will escalate. Rough ETA from infra was 'early April' for managed EKM, but we need a concrete date for Novara. Also Novara asked for SOC2 evidence and our retention policy doc. I can attach current docs.

raj: Quick note — legal flagged the Novara DPA redline around data residency. We need product confirmation on ability to restrict data to eu-west-1 for that tenant. Lina, any updates?

lina: We can pin workloads to eu-west-1 for dedicated/dedicated-lite customers. For hosted customers, we can route by region but not strictly isolate until we spin up a dedicated instance. Novara asked for strict isolation so we should surface dedicated capacity as an option.

alex: Good — I'll position dedicated during the call. Can eng confirm time to stand up a dedicated instance and estimate cost delta? @simon?

simon: For a minimal dedicated pool we need ~2 weeks ops work + capacity ordering, but if they accept a config-based isolation (soft isolation) it's immediate. Cost delta estimate I'll DM you later.

emma: For FinEdge onboarding: CS will need SSO + SCIM set up. I filed the onboarding ticket #432 and linked their security contact. No blocker from their side.

maria: Security asks from OrionData: they want an inbound IP allowlist + audit log export to their S3. We support both but need to confirm retention window for logs (they asked 1 year). Simon — can retention be configured per-tenant?

simon: Retention is configurable on Dedicated and Private. For hosted it's global currently, but we can set up a pipeline to export to customer S3 for retention claims. That would be a small engineering task (1 sprint) + infra changes.

alex: Action items: 1) @maria escalate EKM timeline & SOC2 docs to Novara 2) @simon confirm dedicated instance lead time + cost 3) @lina confirm region-isolation wording for sales pitch 4) @emma start FinEdge SSO ticket.

maria: Also a heads-up — Novara asked about audit logs accessible via console + raw export. We should confirm the console view is included in the SOW or if it's an add-on. Legal will push if not explicit.

raj: Minor engineering ask — I pinged eng-releases about PR #987 (sales-telemetry) to add a small flag for tenant-level logs. Need eng review to land before we promise exports. @simon can you nudge the reviewers?

simon: Yep, I'll nudge the release owners and add it to next sprint grooming.

alex: Cool. Any urgent blockers not covered?

lina: No blockers from product, but please avoid promising EU isolation on hosted plans.

emma: FinEdge wants a checklist for go-live (SSO, billing, support SLAs). I'll draft and share by EOD.

sec-bot: Reminder — security questionnaire (OrionData) due in 48h. Current completeness: 60% (need HSM details, data residency, and incident response contact).

alex: Thanks everyone — I'll run the Novara call at 3pm. Ping me on slack for any updates. :thumbsup:

maria: Updated the thread with SOC2 + retention docs link: https://docs.redwood/company/security/soc2-2025.pdf

raj: Noted. I'll coordinate with legal on DPA redlines after your call.

simon: Nudge sent for PR #987. Tagged eng-oncall and eng-releases.

emma: Shared FinEdge go-live checklist draft: https://docs.redwood/onboarding/finedge-checklist.md

alex: Great — closing out. If anything changes post-call I'll post a quick summary here.
